description: Approved differences between gtfs.guru and MobilityData/gtfs-validator on the mdb-50 catalogue set (scripts/real_world/mdb50.json), in the same format as expected_deltas.json. mdb_parity.py compare loads expected_deltas.json first, so feeds shared with the 12-feed corpus (mdb-3234, mdb-502) are approved there and not repeated here. Totals are pinned: a difference that changes size loses its approval and resurfaces.

entries.reason: Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). agency.txt rows 24 and 89 repeat an agency_id that both validators see. Java reports nothing because nine agency.txt rows carry an invalid_url (agency_url is '-', reported by both validators as 9 invalid_url), its loader marks the whole table UNPARSABLE_ROWS, and every validator injecting the agency table, DuplicateKeyValidator included, is skipped for the feed. gtfs.guru keeps rows with field-level parse errors. Kept: the duplicate keys are real.

Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). The 555 frequencies.txt rows with start_time equal to end_time are the same 555 rows whose headway_secs is 0, which both validators report as number_out_of_range. Java drops those rows before validation (number_out_of_range marks frequencies.txt UNPARSABLE_ROWS and the frequencies validators are skipped), so it never sees the equal ranges. gtfs.guru keeps the rows. Kept: the notice is correct on the data.

Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). Same skip as start_and_end_range_equal: Java's OverlappingFrequencyValidator is not run once frequencies.txt has unparsable rows (555 number_out_of_range on headway_secs). gtfs.guru validates the rows that did parse and finds one overlapping pair. Kept.

Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). feed_info.txt row 2 has neither feed_contact_email nor feed_contact_url. Java drops that row before validation because feed_publisher_url is empty (the feed's single missing_required_field, reported by both validators), so FeedContactValidator sees an empty table and stays silent. gtfs.guru keeps rows with field-level errors. Same mechanism as mdb-3234 in expected_deltas.json. Kept: the contact fields really are missing.

Triaged 2026-09-15 (canon parity). The one pair Java reports and gtfs.guru does not is trip 3467, stops 11797 and 4090 on shape 952: both stops match the same shape vertex (13.758416, 100.616676), so their positions along the shape differ only by the rounding of one segment length (haversine on the vertex against the S2Point angle to the match). The matcher is now an operation-for-operation port of S2EdgeUtil.getClosestPoint and S2LatLng.getDistance, but that last rounding comes from sin/cos/asin/atan2 themselves, which are HotSpot's fdlibm on the JVM and Apple's libm here and differ in the last ulp. Every other shape-matching notice on this feed (63 stop_has_too_many_matches_for_shape, the other 71 out-of-order pairs) agrees. Kept as a known ulp-level difference.
